title: ingcebo eyacwila ngaphansi kokuziqhenya
intro: Cabanga ngokuma phambi kwezinqwaba zengcebo enkulu kangangokuthi ukuphatha nje izihluthulelo kungakhathaza iqembu labantu abanamandla. Abantu abakuzungezile, amazwi akhuthaza ukuthobeka nokukhumbula, kodwa ukuqhosha kukhula kakhulu kunokubonga. Kwenzekani lapho ukuphana kuba isivivinyo futhi ukuzikhukhumeza kuvala umphumela?
clues: Nganikwa ingcebo enkulu kangangokuthi izihluthulelo zayo zazizothwala iqembu lamadoda anamandla.
Abantu bami bangicebisa ukuthi ngingathokozi futhi ngifune iLife Elaphakade ngaphandle kokukhohlwa isabelo sami saleli zwe.
Ngathi lokho enginakho ngikuphiwe ngenxa yolwazi enganginalo.
Ngahamba phambi kwabantu bami ngihlobile, futhi labo abafisa ukuphila emhlabeni babefisa okufana nalokho enganginakho.
Ngagwinywa umhlaba kanye nendawo yami yokuhlala, futhi akekho owayengangisiza futhi akekho owayengakwazi ukuzisiza.

arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِۦ وَبِدَارِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُۥ مِن فِئَةٍۢ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنتَصِرِينَ
verse: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allāh, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves. (28:81)
